# Turning On Pixfizz POS

# Point of Sale: Turning On Pixfizz POS

Pixfizz POS is switched on for your whole store from OrderHub. Once it's on, the rest of the POS settings appear, and you can add tills.

* Note: Only a lab administrator can change these settings.

---

## Switching it on

1. In OrderHub, click **Settings** and open the **POS** tab.
2. Turn on **Enable Pixfizz POS**.
3. Read the confirmation, **Enable Pixfizz POS?**, and tick **I agree to the $65 per month charge for Pixfizz POS.**
4. Click **Enable**.

![POS Switch on](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/370c452c-6e5d-4ef5-8084-b59d478b817e.png)

The card then shows who enabled it and when. The **Pixfizz POS** card and the other POS settings now appear below it.

---

## Setting your tax rate

The till needs to know whether to charge sales tax **before it will let you sell**.

1. On the same tab, find the **Pixfizz POS** card.
2. Either:
    * enter your rate in **POS Tax Percentage** (for example 6 or 6.25) and click **Save**, or
    * if your business doesn't charge sales tax, leave the rate empty and tick **This business does not charge sales tax (0% is correct)**.

![POS Tax Rate](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/51843a28-4baa-4e72-9229-ea98d616bea5.png)

* Note: You can't simply enter 0. To charge no tax, use the checkbox, so that 0% is a deliberate choice and not a missed setting.
* Note: Until one of these is set, the card shows an amber warning and the till won't allow sales.

---

## Switching it off

Turn off **Enable Pixfizz POS** on the **POS** tab.

* Note: You can't switch it off while tills are still paired. First remove or deactivate each till under **Settings** → **Pixfizz** tab → your website → **Locations** tab → **Edit** → **POS/Film Terminals**.

---
